resolved_scenario.purpose: Harder controlled setting with more identity fragmentation, wording drift, generic/repeated text, CPV degradation, and successor timing dispersion.

scoped_candidate_environment.note: v0.3 temporal/candidate revision block. These are FIDELITY_TUNED scenario parameters, not empirical estimates: they were selected by the bounded sweep in scripts/generate_synthetic_benchmark_v0_3_temporal_candidate_revision.py against candidate-environment gates, and the selected set is recorded in candidate_revision_selected_parameters.csv and in generation_metadata.json#candidate_revision. They live in this file rather than only in metadata so the released benchmark replays from configuration. Selection history: these values were re-swept again after aligning the synthetic benchmark defaults to the real BOAMP prepared corpus (19,200 buyers, 84,623 target notices, 2015-03-02 through 2026-07-13). The earlier pilot-scale setting (activity Pareto shape 0.90, high scoped-need probability 0.70, near-window share 0.80, recurrence multiplier 0.88, and hard-negative alignment rate 0.34) over-produced dense candidate neighborhoods once generated at real population scale. The current setting is the one written above: affinity share 0.102, high scoped-need probability 0.54, near-window share 0.90, recurrence multiplier 1.60, and hard-negative alignment rate 0.00. In the central seed it preserves BOAMP-scale digital source count, overall zero-candidate rate, NAME_FALLBACK and RAW_SIRET zero-candidate rates, p75/p90/p95 candidate counts, and cap-hit rate within the documented gates. Candidate counts remain post-hoc fidelity targets: this block controls plausible scoped recurrence timing and same-buyer distinct-need clustering, while preserving overall digital source scale. It never sets per-source candidate counts, linkage scores, accepted links, or thresholds.

conditional_siret_presence.note: Overrides the older year-regime scale for central_provisional in the v0.2 conditional revision. The target is checksum-clean SIRET presence; the absent mass is still split into SIREN-only, invalid, and missing official-identifier outcomes so the corruption vocabulary remains compatible with the current linkage pipeline. The global presence_scale preserves the conditional shape while aligning the release-candidate marginal SIRET presence rate after the v0.3 source-density revision.

conditional_presence.note: Overrides missing_rate_by_schema for central_provisional in the v0.2 conditional revision. Presence is estimated by observable schema/year/type rates. When present, the visible declared duration is sampled from valid raw BOAMP duration values instead of being rounded from hidden cycle length; latent true contract-cycle timing remains generated by the clean-world mechanism and is not inferred from BOAMP.

conditional_reuse.note: Replaces the high global boilerplate_rate in central_provisional v0.2. It separates exact cross-buyer template reuse from near-boilerplate text with row-specific tokens and generic weak procurement wording. This reduces unrealistic cross-buyer exact duplicates while preserving repeated administrative language. Same-family CALL/AWARD wording remains exact when the observed buyer key is stable. The corruption layer adds a stable attribution suffix only when notice-level SIRET/name-key differences would otherwise make a family duplicate look like cross-buyer generic boilerplate. High-activity buyers also reuse an observable-buyer-key administrative title at a calibrated rate, increasing within-corpus duplicate share without pooling text across unrelated buyer keys.

conditional_observation.note: Added after notebooks/07_synthetic_conditional_fidelity_validation.ipynb. Builds smoothed observable-rate tables for SIRET presence, duration presence, and exact cross-buyer repeated text. This changes only observed/corrupted fields; latent truth and CPV missingness remain governed by their existing mechanisms.

resolved_scenario.scenario_design_note: Deliberately imposes stronger recall ceilings and candidate ambiguity than moderate. It is a sensitivity/stress scenario, not an empirical estimate of BOAMP recurrence or algorithm performance.
